value.message: Town of Oakville runs Preschool A Learn to Swim Saturdays 9:00-9:30am, Sept 12 to Nov 28, for 3-5 year olds (no parent in water) - their site says. Fees aren't posted yet, set by Council in the Recreation Guide. Fall registration opens Aug 11 at 7am for residents. I'll keep watching and text you when fees post.
